t: In front of you, floating on the Regent's Canal, are five life-sized sharks. This is Sharks!, an art installation by the architect and sculptor Jaimie Shorten. It began as the winning concept in the 2020 Antepavilion, an annual art contest, and was then built. The sharks sit on floating platforms in front of the art centre in the repurposed docks at 55 Laburnum Street, in Hoxton, in the Borough of Hackney. Look across the water and you can see them cruising along the canal.
